items.title: Junior Mance Part II interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, January 18, 1999 [interview 2 of 2]
items.q: Benny Powell proposed a project we’re going to do soon, called the Trio of Griots... And Billy Harper, the tenor player. So I guess the three of us were the ones who were doing it most

ctx.x: So now, I found out I wasn’t the only one, that Benny Powell the trombone player does the same thing, well he’s got quite a history too. And Billy Harper, the tenor player. So I guess the three of us were the ones who were doing it most you know, so Benny Powell proposed a project we’re going to do soon, called the Trio of Griots. I think Griot means —
